H14.bridge_requirement: Strict registered Source144 input bridge; no refit, registry alias or old-data/new-tag qualification.

H16.purpose: Measurement identification only; no forecast score or controller-performance claim.
collection_blocked_until: Exact new source/core/cost/observer/capture/protocol identity is sealed and independently qualified before exposure.
The existing identification03 backend ownership has ended; no cohort or source injection into its ongoing runs.
Owner-journal opt-in, actual written-row closure, ID-less refusal, common source/receipt clock domains and complete assigned-client inventory are qualified.
Any source/configuration/protocol change is separately sealed before collection; it cannot inherit this candidate binding silently.
H16.Q1: Every epoch passes the strict owner-journal verifier, including written-versus-producer sequence, complete suffix, bytes/SHA, drops/errors/unflushed rows and remaining-owner checks; any failure stops with UNIDENTIFIED and retains its reason.
H16.Q2: At every same-run/domain Gateway snapshot, replayed owner UUID set equals the snapshot set and reserved stocks agree to 1e-6.
H16.Q3: For every offered client UUID, Gateway accept iff journal admission; 503 iff no admission; journal terminal <= client HTTP terminal in the qualified common domain. Report lags without selecting a favorable threshold.
H16.Q4: Every native-visible gateway_request_id has an earlier journal admission; rejected-and-native-visible count is zero.
H16.Q5: Every assigned budget slot has a matching control row with actual apply lag, or remains noncompliant in the assigned ITT denominator. Every admission decision satisfies R(d-)+c <= B(d); violations must be zero.
outputs: Producer-event stock and independently labeled received-prefix/watermark state
Carry-over, action-contrast and actual count-support tables
H16.online_state_boundary: Final seals do not certify precut reception. A received prefix describes its source watermark, not exact current stock at a later cut; unknown suffix/owners/fates remain unknown.
H16.stop_rule: Run once on the first complete sealed pair. Any Q1-Q5 failure is UNIDENTIFIED; no replacement by favorable epochs or held-out relabels.

separate_future_preregistration_required: Any count-axis actuation or new controller benchmark
